Pancakeswap is a decentralized exchange that operates on the BNB Smart Chain. Pancakeswap uses an automated market maker model for token swaps. Pancakeswap has a native governance and utility token called CAKE.

Bakeryswap is a decentralized exchange that operates on the BNB Smart Chain. Bakeryswap uses an automated market maker model for token swaps. Bakeryswap has a native token called BAKE.

Justswap is a decentralized exchange that operates on the TRON network. Justswap uses an automated market maker model for token swaps.

SafeMoon is a token that operates on the BNB Smart Chain. SafeMoon applies a transaction fee mechanism to transfers of its token. SafeMoon is not a financial service that provides lending, trading, or yield generation on its own.

Yearn Finance is a yield aggregation protocol that operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Yearn Finance automatically allocates deposited assets across lending and liquidity protocols through vaults. Yearn Finance has a native governance token called YFI.
